jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. jobs.title: Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to join our Finance team and oversee day-to-day accounts payable operations. This role is responsible for leading a team of AP professionals, ensuring payments are processed accurately and efficiently, maintaining established controls and procedures, and supporting compliance and audit requirements. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, improving processes, and partnering cross-functionally to support business operations while maintaining appropriate financial controls.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable Manager to join our Finance team and oversee day-to-day accounts receivable operations. This role is responsible for leading the accounts receivable team, ensuring timely collections and cash application, supporting established credit and collections processes, and providing accurate reporting on receivables activity. The position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, resolving customer billing issues, and partnering cross-functionally to support efficient business operations.

jobs.title: Customer Success Architect
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Customer Success Architect is part of a highly collaborative team of digital forensic, investigative, and technology subject-matter experts. The team partners across Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to guide customers through implementation, adoption, optimization, and expansion while helping them achieve measurable value from Magnet solutions. As a Customer Success Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from solution evaluation and design through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. You will help customers deploy and scale Magnet solutions within complex environments by combining deep expertise in enterprise networking, security, cloud and hybrid architectures, integrations, investigative workflows, and troubleshooting with a strong understanding of customer goals and business outcomes. Working closely with Customer Success Managers and cross-functional teams, you will reduce technical barriers, accelerate time to value, strengthen adoption, and establish repeatable technical success practices that scale across the customer base. You will also provide technical continuity at key customer transition points to ensure requirements, expectations, and business objectives remain aligned.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As the Manager, Customer Success, you will be responsible for driving measurable outcomes, strengthening strategic relationships, and delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience for a new flagship customer. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for the customer relationship, ensuring the flagship customer receives a seamless and confident journey with Magnet. Through proactive engagement, strategic planning, and cross-functional coordination with Sales, Professional Services, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal teams, you’ll ensure the customer realizes sustained value from Magnet’s products and services, achieves their business objectives, and builds a long-term partnership with Magnet. In addition to leading customer success strategy and execution, you’ll directly lead a team of two Technical Support Engineers, ensuring strong technical engagement, timely issue resolution, proactive risk identification, and a seamless connection between technical support and the broader customer success strategy. This role reports to the Director, Customer Success.

jobs.title: Platform Sales Consultant (Bilingual Spanish or Italian)

They will also assist in proactive market engagement and business development activities to identify and increase demand for our platform products leading to increased solution sales success. A second European language especially Spanish would be a distinct advantage.

jobs.description_text: Role Overview At Magnet Forensics Inc, the Sales Development Reps are the frontlines of the Customer experience. Working closely with the Sales and Marketing teams, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a key player in our strategic growth plans. Through a combination of top of funnel activities, including both inbound lead response and outbound prospecting, the SDR will generate and qualify sales opportunities for our Account Executives. The most exciting part of this role is the opportunity for growth. At Magnet Forensics, successful SDRs will learn the fundamentals of Sales and Marketing providing a foundation for a career in Business Development, Sales, Marketing and more! Who Should Apply: As a successful candidate for this role, you are passionate about developing new skills and building a network of peers & mentors. You are motivated by healthy competition and you’re eager to be the leader of a winning group or team. You display resiliency when faced with adversity, and ultimately, you are naturally curious, consistently looking for novel ways to solve problems and improve processes.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Magnet Forensics Order Operations team plays a critical role at Magnet, ensuring our customers receive their products in a timely and accurate manner. This team is a highly motivated, detail-oriented group who focus on continual improvement and upping their game to delight our customers and internal stakeholders. The Sales Operations Analyst is responsible for the end of sale cycle within the organization. In this role, you will maintain salesforce contract data, fulfil licenses, invoice customers, ship products to external Customers and work with the internal teams to meet Customer needs and ensure contractual compliance.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on our Architecture team, you’ll help shape the foundation of how all our SaaS products are built and experienced. Our goal is to enable product teams to deliver faster, safer, and more consistent customer experiences, and you’ll play an instrumental role in that journey. You’ll collaborate with Senior Engineers, Product Managers, and UX Designers to create a cohesive frontend platform that unites multiple SaaS products into a single, scalable application. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: Part Architect, Part Builder, and Part Mentor. You’ll lead by example, designing reusable UI frameworks, modernizing legacy codebases, and guiding engineering teams toward better patterns, tooling, and practices. There are no people management requirements for this role. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Faire évoluer nos produits par petits pas, avec une rétroaction constante de l'équipe et de nos clients, c'est pour nous la façon la plus efficace de créer de la vraie valeur. En tant que chargé·e de projet Agile, tu es au cœur de cette dynamique. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu sais motiver les équipes pour assurer la livraison des projets de manière optimale, tout en respectant le budget, le calendrier et la portée.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) Fullstack
jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. À l’aise autant côté front-end que back-end, et c'est cette polyvalence qui te permet de naviguer avec fluidité entre les différentes couches d'un produit et d’en saisir l’ensemble de la complexité. Ton enthousiasme pour le développement te pousse naturellement à relever des défis stimulants et à rester à l'avant-garde des technologies. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellents produits et services qui t'apporte de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. C'est pourquoi tu aspires constamment à t’entourer des personnes les plus talentueuses, afin de progresser et d'évoluer collectivement.

jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. Au cœur de l’équipe, tu coordonnes les différentes expertises afin d’assurer l’alignement, une communication fluide et l’atteinte des objectifs. Tu accompagnes des clients issus de divers secteurs d’activité et les aides à se réinventer grâce à des produits de haute qualité, en tenant compte de leur réalité, de leurs contraintes et de leur budget. Tu es convaincu·e que les produits numériques représentent une occasion unique de répondre aux besoins des personnes utilisatrices, de simplifier leur quotidien et de contribuer à un monde meilleur.

jobs.title: Représentant(e), développement des affaires
jobs.description_text: Au cœur de la croissance de Mirego, en tant que responsable du développement des affaires, tu identifies et qualifies des opportunités de vente à fort potentiel, tu construis des relations authentiques et tu communiques clairement la valeur de ce que Mirego crée. L’objectif est d’alimenter l'équipe de ventes en opportunités qualifiées, en s'appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des besoins des clients potentiels et en alignant ces besoins avec l’offre de services de Mirego.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

The executive director will operate with significant autonomy, yet in close coordination with the Chief Innovation Officer and NJIA’s senior staff, and work closely with team members across the organization. As a part of the team, your responsibilities may include:

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (InnovateNJ)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a nimble product designer who is ready to both lead and dive into all parts of product design. You should be comfortable working in a startup environment where you think independently and operate with a high degree of autonomy. We’re looking for self-starters who are skilled at driving projects forward while communicating and collaborating closely with the team. This position will report to the Product Design Director and collaborate closely with relevant Initiative Directors to align their team’s work with the broader initiative strategy.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with engineers, program leaders, manufacturing teams, and senior executives and understands how complex defense systems move from development into production. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.title: Data Labeling Specialist
jobs.description_text: NextGen Federal Systems is seeking a detail-oriented Mid-Level Data Labeling Specialist to support Artificial Intelligence Operations (AIOPS) initiatives within the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) environment. This role will focus on preparing, annotating, categorizing, and validating structured and unstructured data for use within existing AI platforms and operational applications. Electrify Britain is backed by EDF, Octopus Energy and E.ON, and works with a growing coalition of businesses through Electrify Business. Our work runs from household bills and the Warm Homes Plan to industrial electricity costs, EVs and reindustrialisation, and the rules that decide how fast heat pumps, solar, batteries and chargers get installed. We publish our own State of Electrification tracker, commission independent economic analysis, deliver high impact stunts and creative comms, and brief ministers, special advisers, officials and MPs directly. We get out of the bubble and talk to people, industry and communities about their experience of electrification, making this massive opportunity tangible for the media and politicians. The next twelve months are busy. The government is writing a ten-year plan, consulting on the ZEV mandate, scaling up Warm Homes Plan delivery and changing the way we pay energy bills. We are hiring a Policy and Advocacy Manager to help us turn evidence into arguments and campaigns that move those decisions. jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. The compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. The compensation range for this role is $115,000 - $250,000 This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Opportunistic - General Application
jobs.description_text: General Application DESCRIPTION We want to hear from you. Long Wall is growing quickly across engineering, manufacturing, test, and business operations, and new positions open regularly. This general application lets you share your background with our recruiting team so we can reach out when a role matches your skills and interests. We review general applications on a rolling basis and will contact you directly if there is a potential fit. When a specific posting matches your background, we encourage you to apply to that role as well. Note: Submitting here is not an application to a specific position and does not guarantee an interview.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: Sr. Director, Manufacturing DESCRIPTION The Senior Director, Manufacturing will lead Long Wall’s manufacturing organization, ensuring the company can rapidly develop, build, test, and scale the next generation of missile defense systems. Operating in a highly integrated aerospace environment, you will be responsible for building the teams, capabilities, facilities, and operational systems required to support hardware programs from early development through production. This role provides leadership across both Manufacturing Operations and Manufacturing Engineering, ensuring new products are industrialized efficiently while maintaining world-class execution on cost, quality, schedule, and safety. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced, engineering-driven environments and has a proven track record of building high-performing teams, standing up new manufacturing capabilities, and delivering complex hardware under aggressive schedules. The compensation range for this role is $275,000 - $325,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

jobs.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
jobs.description_text: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

jobs.title: Artist & Label Partnerships Manager - GSA (15-month fixed-term)
jobs.description_text: We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization. In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

jobs.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology. We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Core Experience Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Core Experience team builds the foundations that make Spotify feel connected, intuitive, and consistent wherever people listen. From Playlists to shared product capabilities, we help teams across Spotify create experiences that millions of listeners use every day. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape the future of these platforms. You'll set product direction, bring teams together around shared priorities, and help create the capabilities that make great listening experiences possible at scale. This is an opportunity to influence how Spotify's products evolve while making a meaningful impact on listeners and creators around the world.

jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description_text: Every great Spotify experience starts with access. From creating an account to signing in and managing your identity, these foundational moments shape how millions of people connect with the music, podcasts, and content they love. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our User Platform team and help make these experiences simpler, smarter, and more delightful. You'll work at the intersection of design, product, and engineering, tackling complex challenges across authentication, account management, and emerging AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to bring exceptional craft to essential user journeys, explore new technologies, and shape experiences that reach millions of people. We value designers who are curious, hands-on, collaborative, and excited to turn ambitious ideas into beautifully executed products.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)
jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.
